topic: That clunk into gear after your car's been sitting
negativePromptStanding: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: You shift into Drive — and there's a delay. Then a clunk.
beats.visualPrompt: Static close-up on an instrument-cluster gear-position indicator in dim early-morning garage light; the indicator shifts from 'P' to 'D' with a visible half-second pause before it settles, static-mounted camera.

beats.narration: It's worse first thing in the morning, or after the car's been parked a while.
beats.visualPrompt: Wide shot of a car sitting in a driveway or garage at dawn, light frost or dew on the windshield implying an overnight park; cut to exhaust vapor rising from the tailpipe at idle in cool air.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two ~2.5s sub-shots before real generation to satisfy the 1.5-2.5s visual-change cadence.

beats.narration: One clue: low or worn transmission fluid can cause that delayed engagement.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro cutaway: a transmission dipstick held against a bright shop light, fluid level sitting below the 'full' mark, fluid tinted slightly reddish-brown, slow push-in on the dipstick tip.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots (wide + macro push-in) before real generation.

beats.narration: Ignore it long enough, and that hesitation can turn into real wear on the internal clutches.
beats.visualPrompt: Slow-motion macro of transmission fluid drops falling from the dipstick tip onto a white paper towel, showing color and clarity, shallow depth of field, shop-bay ambient light.

beats.narration: Don't guess what's causing it. A fluid level and condition check can help narrow it down.
beats.visualPrompt: Underside/lift-bay shot: a vehicle raised on a lift, transmission pan visible from below, a shop light illuminating the pan bolts, static hold.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots before real generation.

beats.narration: Worth checking before it gets worse. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold.
